text: Built a TypeScript order API with PostgreSQL indexes, reducing p95 query latency to 180 ms.
Trained a Python forecasting model on 8k records and improved mean absolute error by 18%.
Implemented MQTT retry buffering in C for 24 sensors, reducing packet loss from 8% to 1.5%.
Created React alert tables with REST pagination for 14 categories, cutting review time to 90 minutes.
Automated STM32 calibration with Python across 400 samples, reducing fixture setup to 12 minutes.
Packaged a Go gRPC edge service with Docker and SQLite migrations for offline deployments.
